EmailTemplate.name: MOD - QB - COVID
EmailTemplate.subject: {!Case.Merchant_Number__c} - {!Account.Legal_Name__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We’ve received your request for temporary loan modification due to the Covid-19 pandemic.
We understand these are extremely difficult times and small businesses have been hit especially hard. To expedite your request, please provide the following documents: - March bank statements - April month to date bank transaction history
For faster processing, please answer the following: - What payment assistance are you looking for? i.e. partial or 50% payments, etc. - When will you be able to resume payment? Please provide a date or estimated date
Please reply to this email with all the requested information and attachments. Once received, our team will review and a credit manager will respond as soon as possible*. We wish you and your family the best during this difficult time. Visit our site for updates and support for our customers: https://www.nationalfunding.com/SBAloans
Thank you,
Loan Modification Team
National Funding, Inc., the parent and servicing company of Quick Bridge Funding, LLC 9820 Towne Centre Drive San Diego, CA 92121
*To ensure your request is processed in a timely manner: - Reply directly to this email with all the requested attachments and information - Do not delete any content in the body of this email, including this code:
Code: {!Case.Email_Thread_ID__c}
